title.narrative: TMBD E-commerce and Digital Economy (ECDE) Programme

description.narrative: Following from the successful collaboration between UNCTAD and the Australian government’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) in the context of the Pacific Digital Economy Programme (PDEP), UNCTAD’s E-Commerce and Digital Economy (ECDE) Branch has worked with DFAT to develop a project in support of e-commerce and the digital economy in South and Southeast Asian developing countries. The project is built around three main components as follows: 1) eTrade Readiness Assessments, E-Commerce Strategies/Action Plans and/or sustained implementation support; 2) eTrade for Women; and 3) the UNCTAD eWeek 2023 and 2025/26. Within the planned duration of the project, UNCTAD will also offer a group of selected government officials and private sector representatives (small businesses) from South and Southeast Asian developing countries the possibility to participate to the next Ministerial Conference of UNCTAD (UNCTAD XVI).
